title: Share the good news
caption: After a good month, Zoya wanted her customers to see her shop was in good shape. Lumi tells her story.
linkedin_text: When a ScoreMyBiz score reaches Healthy or Thriving, the owner can share a square picture of the score ring, the band and his business name on his WhatsApp status. It never shows money amounts, and it is his own score, not a certificate.

cast.zoya: Zoya, a young Indian woman who runs a small bakery, with a braid over one shoulder, in a pink kurta and a white apron

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a small bright bakery with cakes under glass domes behind her, a warm smile.
